purpose: Verify module scope and external policy boundary
action_or_input: Inspect services and endpoints
expected_result: Payment, accounting, payroll, and procurement excluded

purpose: Operational role assignment and immediate handoff
action_or_input: Assign Caretaker/Warden and reassign mid-cycle
expected_result: Single active role enforced; pending requests handoff

purpose: Mess Admin operational data access boundary
action_or_input: Admin queries operational student data
expected_result: Access denied HTTP 403 Forbidden

purpose: Mess registration request lifecycle
action_or_input: Student submits, Caretaker approves/rejects
expected_result: Registration lifecycle states persisted

purpose: Mess deregistration lifecycle with next-day effect
action_or_input: Submit deregistration, Caretaker approves
expected_result: Effective from next calendar day

purpose: Warden operational request oversight
action_or_input: Warden views requests and attempts action
expected_result: View allowed; decision actions blocked

purpose: Student request tracking and notifications
action_or_input: Track request history and verify email signals
expected_result: Status timeline returned; notification events fired

purpose: Weekly menu management and access
action_or_input: Maintain day/meal menu items and query

purpose: Monthly billing management and student access
action_or_input: Compute served days, special food, rebates; finalize/publish
expected_result: Published bills and balances accessible to Students

purpose: Feedback recording and review
action_or_input: Student submits text; Caretaker/Warden view
expected_result: Feedback stored and readable; no resolution workflow

purpose: Rebate submission and validation guards
action_or_input: Validate reason, duration >= 3 days, lead time >= 1 day, no overlap
expected_result: Valid rebates accepted; boundary violations rejected

purpose: Rebate decision, date modification, and billing link
action_or_input: Caretaker modifies dates and approves
expected_result: Approved modified dates applied to monthly bill

purpose: Vacation survey setup and notifications
action_or_input: Create survey with deadline for registered students
expected_result: Survey open; creation notification triggered

purpose: Vacation survey response, default No, and summary
action_or_input: Record Yes/No and trigger default No at deadline
expected_result: Response recorded and summary available to Caretaker

purpose: Special food request submission and lead time
action_or_input: Submit request with >= 1 calendar day lead
expected_result: Request accepted; submission notification triggered

purpose: Special food decision and default timeout rejection
action_or_input: Caretaker decides or decision timeout expires
expected_result: Status updated to Approved/Rejected or Rejected(Default)

purpose: Special food FSM status, fulfillment, and billing link
action_or_input: Transition to Served or Cancelled; add charges to bill
expected_result: FSM progression enforced; charges billed

purpose: Mess announcements and history access
action_or_input: Publish announcement and query history
expected_result: Announcement recorded and notified to Students

purpose: Warden supervisory reporting
action_or_input: Search registered students, rebates, vacation summaries
expected_result: Supervisory report data returned

purpose: Caretaker operational reporting
action_or_input: Generate registration trends, meal logs, billing summary
expected_result: Operational report data returned

purpose: MMS report scope boundary
action_or_input: Attempt to request external financial or payroll reports
expected_result: Unsupported; reports limited to MMS operational data

purpose: Notification governance and external email boundary

expected_result: Notification signal triggered; external delivery decoupled
